features.name: Open a local PDF
steps: Tap the folder button in the bottom-right corner
Bring up the system file picker
Enter a directory such as Download
features.expected: Verify that a PDF can be selected through the Android file picker; the document is displayed correctly; after returning the PDF appears in "recent" and the library; the page count, file size, and recent-open information are preserved

features.name: Recently read list
steps: On first launch confirm that "recent" is empty
Tap the card again to open
features.expected: Recent records must persist; thumbnails, titles, and reading progress change with the reading state; they still exist after restarting the app

features.name: Library auto-indexing
steps: Verify that the file appears in "all files"
features.expected: "Recent" and "Library" are not the same state; removing from recent records must not directly delete the library record

features.name: Folder-view browsing
features.expected: The current path, directory hierarchy, and back behavior must be maintained; document thumbnails, page counts, and file sizes are shown

features.name: Folder hierarchy / tile mode
steps: Return to check the change in file organization
features.expected: The two modes need to produce actual layout/navigation changes and persist the configuration

features.name: Basic continuous-scroll PDF reading
features.expected: Core PDF rendering capability; multiple pages, loading, scroll position, and page boundaries must be handled correctly; the whole PDF must not be treated as one static long image

features.name: Reading-progress save and restore
steps: Return to the home page and observe the progress
features.expected: The previous reading position must be restored; the home card should show the corresponding page number/percentage; progress is file state rather than a single session

features.name: Reading-state management
steps: Set to "to read / reading / paused / finished / abandoned" respectively
features.expected: The library provides "all files, to read, reading, paused, finished, abandoned"; state changes must immediately affect the filtered results and persist

features.name: Search the library
features.expected: Filter in real time or after submitting; show a reasonable empty state when there are no results; searching must not damage the library's original state

features.name: Remove from recent records
steps: Return to the recent page to check it disappeared
Confirm on the library page that the file still exists
features.expected: Clearly distinguish "recent records" from "library"; the real PDF must not be deleted

features.name: Hide from the library
steps: Return to the library to confirm it is hidden
It can still be found and opened from the folder
features.expected: This is a library-visibility state, not file deletion; the behavior after reopening the file should match the setting

features.name: Open in incognito mode
steps: Check whether recent records, progress, etc. are not recorded by the normal history mechanism
features.expected: Incognito mode must be isolated from normal mode for persistent states such as reading history and progress

features.name: Rename the PDF
steps: Return to the library/folders to confirm the name update
features.expected: It must modify the actual file name or the corresponding file state; illegal file names, duplicate names, etc. should be handled reasonably

features.name: Delete the PDF
steps: Check the library, recent, and folders
features.expected: Deletion is a destructive operation; files, library records, and recent records need to update consistently; cancelling must not change the state

features.name: Share the PDF file
steps: Bring up the Android share sheet
features.expected: The original PDF file should be shared rather than a screenshot or text; the app state is unchanged after cancelling the share

features.name: Document properties
steps: View metadata such as the title and file information/pages
features.expected: The properties should match the currently open file; different PDFs' information must change dynamically

features.name: Dark reading mode
features.expected: Distinguish the app UI theme from the PDF reading-page theme; switching should affect the current document in real time

features.name: Full-screen reading
features.expected: The full-screen state, system bars, and toolbar visibility must be correctly restored; the UI state must not become disordered after gestures

features.name: Controls auto-hide
steps: Verify that the toolbar is hidden
Tap the page to show it again
features.expected: Involves the timing state; user interaction needs to reset the hidden timer

features.name: Open another PDF
steps: Select another PDF with the system file picker
features.expected: The original document's state must be saved; a new document should correctly initialize/restore its own reading state

features.name: Open several PDFs in separate windows
steps: Enable "open PDFs in a separate window"
Use Android recent tasks to view several document tasks
features.expected: Involves the Android Activity/Task lifecycle; different PDFs' reading positions and window states should be isolated

features.name: Page jumping
steps: Then enter a page number near the first/last page
features.expected: Page-number range validation; 1 ≤ page ≤ total pages; an illegal page number must not cause a crash

features.name: In-document text search
features.expected: The PDF text layer must be parsed; matching content is highlighted; the current position is saved; no-match results need feedback

features.name: Zoom to search results
steps: Search for smaller text on the page
features.expected: When enabled the view should automatically locate and zoom to the matching text; when disabled it only needs to center the position

features.name: Accent-insensitive search
steps: Search for an unaccented form in a PDF containing characters such as é/č/ž
features.expected: The search normalization rules must change with the toggle, e.g. é ↔ e; this is an excellent verifiable logic task

features.name: PDF page text selection
steps: Enable "enable text selection on PDF pages"
features.expected: The text layer must be hit precisely and the selection range shown; the selection position must still be correct after zooming and scrolling

features.name: Copy page text
steps: Paste into a verifiable input box
features.expected: The copied content should correspond to the real text order of the current page rather than the whole document or OCR of a screenshot

features.name: Text-mode reading
steps: Read the current PDF as reflowed text
Return to the normal PDF page mode
features.expected: It must parse the text content from the PDF and generate a reflowed view, switching state with the normal page-rendering mode

features.name: Document link browsing
steps: Tap one of the links/internal jumps
features.expected: Distinguish internal page links from external URLs; the back stack must be correct

features.name: Add a bookmark
steps: Turn to another page and add it
Tap the bookmark to jump back to the corresponding page
features.expected: Bookmarks are bound to the file and page number; multiple PDFs must not mix data; they still exist after exiting and re-entering

features.name: My bookmarks collection
steps: Open the "bookmarks" menu/the corresponding management entry
Select a bookmark to open the corresponding file and page
features.expected: A cross-document persistent index; invalid bookmarks must be handled when files are deleted

features.name: Add a highlight
features.expected: A highlight must be bound to the text range and page coordinates; it must still display correctly after zooming/rotating/reloading

features.name: Detect existing highlights
steps: Select exactly the same text that was already highlighted
features.expected: Existing highlight-related actions should be shown rather than creating duplicate new marks

features.name: Highlight-color switching
steps: Choose among the several colors provided
features.expected: The highlight color immediately affects newly created highlights; existing highlights must not be unconditionally recolored

features.name: My highlights
steps: Automatically jump to the corresponding page and position
features.expected: The list and document coordinates are linked in both directions; after deleting a highlight the list updates in sync

features.name: My notes
steps: Create/open notes related to the document while reading the PDF
Select a record and return to the corresponding document position
features.expected: The note must be linked to the PDF; it still exists after a restart; when the file is deleted the link state must be handled reasonably

features.name: In-PDF signature
features.expected: Coordinate conversion between the drawing layer and the PDF page is required; the position is preserved after moving/scaling; cancelling must not produce modifications

features.name: PDF page screenshot
steps: Select/generate a screenshot of the current page
features.expected: The screenshot should correspond to the visible content of the current page or the page output; other pages must not be captured by mistake

features.name: Hide PDF page margins
steps: "Hide page margins" or set "always hide page margins"
Compare a PDF with obvious blank margins before and after
features.expected: First analyze the page boundaries; after cropping the document content area expands; the body text must not be cropped away

features.name: Blank space between pages
steps: Continuously scroll through a multi-page PDF
features.expected: The page spacing should change immediately without changing the page content coordinates or the reading page number

features.name: Anti-aliased rendering
steps: Compare the edges at magnified text/graphics
features.expected: The rendering-pipeline state changes are visible; the layout and text content must not be affected

features.name: High-quality rendering
steps: Open a PDF containing images/color charts
features.expected: The settings page mentions ARGB_8888 / RGB_565; the key test points are the toggle state, re-rendering, visual differences, and persistence

features.name: Independent UI / PDF themes
steps: The PDF theme can be set separately to system/light/dark
features.expected: The app UI and the PDF page theme are two independent states; the combined states must be correct

features.name: Reading-mode switching
steps: Switch reading modes such as "continuous scroll"
features.expected: Different modes should change the paging/scrolling behavior while keeping the current page and zoom state as consistent as possible

features.name: Page-fitting method
steps: View the page width/height adaptation changes
features.expected: The fitting algorithm works on different page sizes; pages must not be cropped abnormally

features.name: Show only on the home page
steps: Enable "show only on the home page separately"
Check the layout relationship between the home page and the subsequent screens in pairs
features.expected: This is a layout-type state; the page numbers and page order must stay correct

features.name: Browser-like scrolling
steps: Scroll vertically on a wide page
Check that accidental horizontal drift is avoided
features.expected: Gesture direction locking is the key point; horizontal movement should only occur on an obvious horizontal swipe

features.name: Page-scroll alignment
steps: Verify that the viewport automatically docks to the page
features.expected: Involves the snap logic after a scroll ends

features.name: Fast page scrolling
steps: Verify that it jumps directly to the next page
features.expected: Unlike ordinary inertial scrolling; fast swipes must be recognized and paged

features.name: Toolbar primary/secondary button customization
steps: Change the "primary toolbar buttons" and "secondary toolbar buttons"
features.expected: The toolbar structure should change according to the configuration; merely saving the setting without reflecting it in the UI is not enough

features.name: Quick-bar action customization
steps: Select the actions the quick bar should show
Return to the reader and bring up the quick bar
features.expected: The operation set, order, and visibility must persist

features.name: Customize the full-screen operations
features.expected: Full-screen and normal modes can have different control sets

features.name: Volume-key page turning
steps: Enable "use volume keys to turn pages"
features.expected: The key events are used for previous/next page rather than only adjusting volume; interception must not continue after leaving the PDF

features.name: Mouse forward/back keys turn pages
steps: Enable "use mouse buttons to turn pages"
Use an input device with forward/back keys
features.expected: Hardware-key mapping; after disabling the option the back button should restore its exit/system behavior

features.name: Automatically enter full screen
features.expected: The file automatically enters full screen each time it is opened; the behavior is consistent after exiting

features.name: Reading-history management
steps: Open several PDFs in succession and change the reading positions
features.expected: The file, reading position, and per-file settings must be recorded; the history is separate from the real PDF files

features.name: Clear the reading history
features.expected: Clear memories such as files, locations, saved passwords/per-document settings, but the PDF files themselves must not be deleted

features.name: Clear the saved password
steps: Open a password-protected PDF and save the password
features.expected: After clearing, the password should be required again; other reading data is preserved

features.name: Clear all bookmarks
features.expected: It is a global destructive state change; it should not clear only the current file

features.name: Clear the highlight-restoration data / saved signatures
features.expected: Note that this is global data management and must not delete the original PDF files

features.name: Keep a copy of the shared file
steps: Hand a PDF to MJ PDF from another app via Android share/open
Keep a copy according to the setting
features.expected: Involves the content:// URI lifecycle; it must be decided whether to copy temporarily shared files into private storage to avoid invalid URIs

features.name: PDF reload
steps: Keep the current document and re-render
features.expected: The page cache is rebuilt; the reading position should not reset to zero for no reason

features.name: Print the PDF
steps: Bring up the Android print UI
features.expected: Correctly provide the current PDF to the system Print Framework; the current reading state is preserved after cancelling

features.name: Online PDF
features.expected: This is a feature clearly present in the screenshot, but the benchmark can treat it as an optional networked task; a load failure must give state feedback

features.name: Backup and restore
steps: Export the settings, reading history, bookmarks, etc.
features.expected: Spans multiple state domains; excellent for verifying full business-state persistence and serialization

features.name: Library statistics
features.expected: Statistics such as counts should change dynamically with the current library

features.name: Scan-location management
steps: Return to the library to check the file-discovery result
features.expected: After adding a directory PDFs should be rediscovered; deleting a scan path is not the same as deleting the original files

features.name: Disable the home library
features.expected: On launch it should invoke the system file picker directly instead of showing the "recent/library/folders" home screen

features.name: PDF title display rules
steps: Return to the library and compare the card name
features.expected: When enabled the PDF metadata title is preferred; when disabled the file name is used

features.name: Library card title rows / truncation
steps: Change the grid header rows, list header rows, and title-truncation mode
features.expected: The line count and ellipsis position for long file names must change noticeably

features.name: Reading-progress indicator
steps: Read several pages of the PDF
View the percentage/progress ring on library cards
features.expected: The progress must update in real time with the reading position

features.name: Show the page count in the scroll handle/toolbar
steps: Enable "show page count in the scroll handle" and "show the page number in the toolbar" respectively
features.expected: The current page/total pages or the corresponding page number should be shown and update immediately after paging

features.name: Navigate back/forward
steps: Make several jumps within a PDF via links, search, and the table of contents
features.expected: The in-document navigation stack must be maintained independently rather than using the Android Activity back stack

features.name: Navigation history
features.expected: Each history entry must restore the corresponding page and view position

features.name: Directory navigation
steps: Open a PDF with an Outline/TOC
features.expected: Nested directories are supported; tapping a chapter jumps to the correct page precisely

features.name: Open document links / combined forward and backward jumps
steps: Enter chapter A in the directory
Search for the keyword and jump to chapter B
Tap the internal link to enter C
features.expected: Comprehensively verify that the navigation history, page state, search state, and internal-link state are unified

features.name: Setting persistence
steps: Change multiple settings such as the theme, scroll mode, toolbar, search, and highlight
features.expected: All user settings must persist across processes; different settings must not override one another
